title: Order death certificates
plain_summary: Most families need several certified copies, one for each bank, insurer, and agency. The funeral home can often order them for you. If not, order from the vital records office in the state where the death happened.
why_now: Banks, insurers, and agencies ask for certified copies, and orders can take a week or more.

citations.authority_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics, Where to Write for Vital Records
